A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same MIO study, with complete text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–28 are identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original MIO evaluations on image, speech and video tasks in Section 3 and Tables 3–6, plus qualitative demonstrations in Figures 2–4.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original MIO benchmark results in Tables 3–6 and demonstrations in Section 3.4 and Appendix F.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same tokenizers, vocabulary expansion, causal modeling objective, speech-token handling, masked packing and four-stage training procedure.

E1.justification: Training datasets and tasks in Tables 2 and 7 and Appendices B–D are unchanged. Section 3 retains exactly the same evaluation benchmarks and demonstration scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within each image understanding, image generation, ASR, TTS and video understanding comparison in Tables 3–6.

E3.justification: The reported splits, metrics, preprocessing, training budgets and evaluation procedures are unchanged, including the decoding settings and prompt templates in Appendix E.

E4.justification: The preliminary speech-token interleaving comparison in Section 2.1 and demonstrations in Section 3.4 and Appendix F are identical. No ablation, robustness test or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-score reporting without evaluation run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 3–6 and qualitative outputs in Figures 2–4 are unchanged. For example, MIO-Instruct retains COCO CIDEr 120.4 in Table 3 and TTS WER 4.2 in Table 5.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation, including the next-token cross-entropy objective in Equation (1), is identical. No definitions, assumptions, derivations or proofs change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about four-modality understanding and generation, interleaved outputs, novelty and competitive benchmark performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Appendix A retains the same limitations concerning OCR and detailed images, control of generated timbre, and continuous raw video generation.

D1.justification: The first-page notice changes from 'Codes and models will be available soon' to stated availability with a clickable GitHub address for MIO-Team/MIO. This adds concrete resource-access information; implementation and hyperparameter disclosures elsewhere are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, comparison with prior approaches, citations and reference list are identical.

P1.justification: Only the first-page availability sentence and arXiv version/date stamp are edited. The remaining prose, headings and organization of the main text and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–4, Tables 1–9, captions and placement are unchanged. The revised first-page notice occupies the same position, with no page-layout reorganization.

improvement.justification: v2 replaces an unspecified future release with a concrete code-and-model repository link, modestly improving resource-access and reproducibility information. Scientific content and appendices remain unchanged. The PDFs alone do not establish the linked repository's contents or completeness.
